runtime_profile_summary: Rust toolchain handled for pre-installed base image (rust:1.70-slim-bookworm). Script now detects existing rustc >= 1.70.0 and skips rustup installation. Activation uses system PATH for pre-installed Rust or sources rustup env when installed.
notes: Fixed setup_runtime.sh to handle pre-existing Rust installations in rust:1.70-slim-bookworm base image. The script now: (1) checks if rustc exists and meets version >= 1.70.0, (2) skips rustup if pre-installed Rust is adequate, (3) only sources cargo env when rustup was actually installed. For the base image with pre-installed Rust, cargo and rustc are already in PATH. The activation command includes '|| true' to handle cases where rustup env file doesn't exist.
